description: Stable semantic lanes. Relationships indicate useful evidence navigation, not inferred joins or required fields. Source narratives remain intact even when they span lanes.

lanes.purpose: Patient identities, identifiers, contact details, preferences, emergency contacts and demographic history.
Documented problems and diagnoses with active, resolved, historical or other source status and applicable dates.
Prescriptions, historical/current lists, start/stop changes, administrations, dose instructions, refills and pharmacy attribution.
Allergens, intolerances, reaction details, severity, dates and documented status.
Vaccine administrations, product/dose/manufacturer/lot details, historical reports and associated schedules.
Atomic quantitative or qualitative measurements including vital signs, laboratory components, ECG metrics and patient-reported readings, preserving units and ranges.
Result panels, diagnostic reports, imaging impressions, specimen/provenance details, interpretations and report status.
Completed or documented surgical, diagnostic and therapeutic procedures with preparation, findings, specimens and complications.
Visits, admissions, appointments and service events, including scheduling state, date/location and attending clinicians.
Clinical narrative, examination, assessment, treatment plan, instructions and signed/amended documentation.
Requested medications, tests, services and procedures, with status, dates, preparation, safety questions and scheduling instructions.
Referral requests, destinations, specialties, service codes, intervals and authorization state.
Screening and preventive service recommendations, source due/overdue/planned states, prior completions and scheduling.
Narrative and structured medical/surgical historical context that cannot safely be reduced to current problems or procedures alone.
Family relationships, living/deceased state, conditions and age of onset with documented attribution.
Tobacco, alcohol, drug, occupational, reproductive and social-context history, including dated determinants of health.
Instrument definitions, individual questions/answers, scores, source classifications, completion/submission state and appointment context.
Clinicians, organizations, pharmacies, roles, relationships, specialties, identifiers, contact details and relationship dates.
Documented targets, patient health goals, source progress states and linked measurements or care plans.
Document/package and attachment metadata, report/consent identity, dates, signatures and preserved content references.
Patient/clinician and automated correspondence with participants, thread identity, timestamps, body, folders and attachments.
Assigned educational materials, assignment dates, contents and source review/completion states.
Healthcare agents, directives, living wills, power of attorney, POLST and other documented advance planning.
Payers/plans, subscriber/relationship identifiers, group/effective dates and authorization context.
Service/account charges, codes, coverage, responsibility, payments, adjustments, statements and assistance material.
Service estimates and source assumptions, deductible/coverage/responsibility, exclusions and estimate documents.
Source account authorization, proxy relationships, linked integrations and audit/access events.
Visible research-study information, participation statements and related documents with visibility limitations.
Dated inspection/capture/extraction scope, source visibility, pagination, empty/unavailable findings, limitations and next steps.
Attributed patient or caregiver notes, symptoms, behaviors, home measurements and corrections, distinct from clinician documentation.
Explicitly identified agent interpretations, calculations and proposed actions with evidence citations, uncertainty, review status and freshness limits.
